flora: Azolla individual plant (tiny, triangular or fan-shaped floating body with overlapping scale-like leaves)
Azolla roots (fine, feathery threads hanging straight down into the water)
Azolla colony (a dense, interlocking mat of many small plants)
Spore-bearing structure (close-up of the small, rounded sporocarps on the underside)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'velvety' or fuzzy texture of the leaves; colors ranging from vibrant green to a rusty red; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single macro view of one plant; Top-Right: The feathery roots submerged in water; Bottom-Left: A dense cluster of the 'mat' formation; Bottom-Right: The small rounded sporocarps.
visual_logic.ground: The background is the surface of still, dark water with reflections of the sky.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to show the texture of the tiny overlapping leaves.
